mapper.sql: FS.FILE_ID, FS.FILE_NAME, FS.R2_KEY, FS.FILE_SIZE, FS.MIME_TYPE, FS.SCOPE, FS.DEPTNO, FS.UPLOADER, FS.UPLOADER_NAME, TO_CHAR(FS.CREATED_AT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS CREATED_AT_STR, D.DNAME
mapper.select: SELECT FROM FILE_SHARE FS LEFT JOIN DEPT D ON FS.DEPTNO = D.DEPTNO WHERE FS.FILE_ID = #{fileId}
SELECT FROM FILE_SHARE FS LEFT JOIN DEPT D ON FS.DEPTNO = D.DEPTNO WHERE FS.SCOPE = #{scope} ORDER BY FS.CREATED_AT DESC
SELECT FROM FILE_SHARE FS LEFT JOIN DEPT D ON FS.DEPTNO = D.DEPTNO WHERE FS.SCOPE = 'DEPT' AND FS.DEPTNO = #{deptno} ORDER BY FS.CREATED_AT DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO FILE_SHARE (FILE_ID, FILE_NAME, R2_KEY, FILE_SIZE, MIME_TYPE, SCOPE, DEPTNO, UPLOADER, UPLOADER_NAME, CREATED_AT) VALUES (FILE_SHARE_SEQ.NEXTVAL, #{fileName}, #{r2Key}, #{fileSize}, #{mimeType}, #{scope}, #{deptno}, #{uploader}, #{uploaderName}, SYSDATE)
